The design is sound and only the gain misses. Simulated gain is −6.755e-3 against a target of −7.0e-3, which is 3.5% low. The model's gm and gmb are slightly optimistic.

Gain scales linearly with Ro, so setting trim to 7.0/6.755 ≈ 1.036 centres it. This also raises Ro by 3.6%. Bandwidth (1.12 GHz against a 300 MHz minimum) and offset (−2.1 mV against ±50 mV) both have plenty of margin for that.
